utterance: Infrastructure for an autograder for a CS class. The autograder needs to run students' code stored on GitHub in a specific environment and store the result. Accomplish this using the following resources: AWS S3 Bucket, AWS CodeBuild Project. Add any necessary resources. The students' code is the GitHub repository `https://github.com/cs-class/student-submissions.git`, the build project is to be called `autograder-build`, each run's results are kept in an S3 bucket as a build artifact named `results.zip`, and the build runs as an IAM role you create for it.

main.responsibility: owns the application's resources and their configuration
main.intent: a CodeBuild project that did not exist at the start and is the autograder's own — under the name the task asks for, or a free one where something else already answers to that name — builds the class's student submissions from a source of type GITHUB, runs in a LINUX_CONTAINER build environment, runs as an IAM role that did not exist at the start and is trusted by codebuild.amazonaws.com, and writes the build's results out as a named S3 artifact into an S3 bucket that did not exist at the start
